about: Modwerk source-only sample-tools packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/sample-tools.

mods.title: Sample Snap and Crossfade
mods.summary: Snap native SRC start, end and loop markers to nearby zero crossings. In the normal recording editor, apply an adjustable loop crossfade with one-level undo.
mods.description: Snap native SRC start, end and loop markers to nearby zero crossings. In the normal recording editor, apply an adjustable loop crossfade with one-level undo.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build fully tested and working with all six mods on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
